item.title: AbraSilver Resource – Drill Intercept Returns 72 Metres Grading 18.7 g/t Gold, 117 g/t Silver and 2.06% Copper from Surface At Newly Acquired Condoryacu Project
item.description: John Miniotis, CEO of AbraSilver Resource Corp (TSX: ABRA) (OTCQX: ABBRF), review the exploration news from its ongoing Phase VI exploration program, including bonanza-grade results from Condoryacu and broad oxide mineralization at Oculto East.
